title: Corporate Hierarchy Matcher
description: An international conglomerate is evaluating two subsidiary corporate management hierarchies to determine if they are structurally and relationally identical. You are given the root nodes of two organizational trees. Write a function to check if the two trees are p-equivalent, meaning they have the exact same structural layout and identical employee IDs assigned to corresponding positions.
constraints: The number of nodes in both trees is in the range [0, 100].
input_format: Two roots of binary trees, root1 and root2.

examples.explanation: Both trees have identical structures and node values.
The right and left placements differ, making them structurally unequal.
The values at the child nodes are swapped.
